title: En última instancia: la conclusión final tras varios factores

sections.content: En última instancia (ultimately, in the final analysis) draws the final, bottom-line conclusion after considering several factors -- a natural closing move for synthesis writing that has already discussed multiple angles. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: El sistema internacional dejó, en última instancia, de existir por completo.
items.english: The international system, in the final analysis, stopped existing altogether.

items.spanish: Washington, en última instancia, reorganizó su propia política hacia la región casi por completo.
items.english: Washington, ultimately, reorganized its own policy toward the region almost entirely.

items.spanish: Para Cuba, en última instancia, la pérdida del patrocinio soviético representó la prueba más directa de esta nueva realidad.
items.english: For Cuba, ultimately, the loss of Soviet sponsorship represented the most direct proof of this new reality.

items.spanish: La región entraba así, en última instancia, en una década marcada por un marco internacional radicalmente distinto.
items.english: The region thus entered, ultimately, a decade marked by a radically different international framework.

sections.content: En última instancia works well after a paragraph has already presented supporting details -- it signals here's what all of this amounts to, similar to a fin de cuentas but slightly more formal and analytical in tone.
